pages.title: Surreal Number
pages.text: Conway built every number from two sets, a left and a right, and found that the reals, the infinite ordinals and the infinitesimals all fit into one ordered field. This gem contains all of them. It is impossibly dense, endlessly fine, and every attempt to find its edge reveals another number there.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)The Cantor Diagonalizer was the only machine with room for this. I fed it octonions, the reals, an aleph-null shard and an infinitesimal, and let dark energy keep expanding the space between them until every gap was a number.
